metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Figure system-overview from .claude/orrery/plan.json, with .claude/orrery/decisions.md (2026-10-22). # Shown in README.md and docs/architecture.md at 880px (GitHub README column). # Hosts: CLAUDE.md Deployment table (sagargupta.online/ledger-sync/, ledger-sync-api.vercel.app). # Left out on purpose: Google Analytics beacon (frontend/index.html:4-18), GitHub Actions and the # Vercel Git deploy (release-delivery figure), local dev SQLite and Vite /api proxy, static # instrument-rate source URLs (no outbound call), browser navigation to the Pages host. # Added by the 2.31.0 wave and left out on purpose: the AMFI NAV file the CAS holdings read downloads # (backend/src/ledger_sync/core/amfi_nav.py:35, one more node in the Market data box would cost the figure # its 880 px score), Web Push delivery from the daily Vercel cron (backend/vercel.json:18-23), the MCP # endpoint at /mcp, and Titan embeddings for Smart search (the Bedrock node below stands for them too). title: Ledger Sync system overview subtitle: "Production: the SPA from sagargupta.online/ledger-sync/ calls ledger-sync-api.vercel.app; local dev swaps in SQLite and the Vite proxy" direction: right # No layout.aspect: 4:3 and 1:1 both reported DG219 (nearest 0.98:1) and the unset layout reviews higher. # Group and node order (OAuth, Neon, market data, then model providers with Bedrock first) keeps the # SPA's browser-direct edges below the API's fan-out: 7 crossings down to 2. layout: { spacing: 0.5 } groups: browser: { type: zone, label: "User's browser", evidence: "frontend/vite.config.ts:58-60" } ghpages: { type: box, label: GitHub Pages, evidence: ".github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:97-110" } # backend/vercel.json:2 regions ["sin1"] vercel: { type: box, label: Vercel (sin1), icon: logos:vercel-icon, evidence: "backend/vercel.json:2-16" } oauth: { type: internet, label: OAuth providers, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/oauth_providers.py:24-31" } neon: { type: box, label: Neon, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/db/session.py:14-39" } market: type: internet label: Market data evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/api/exchange_rates.py:28", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/stock_price.py:23"] llm: { type: internet, label: Model providers, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:249-250" } nodes: # Stand-in: ibm:user, neutral person glyph. Evidence: brief (CLAUDE.md Deployment). user: { icon: ibm:user, label: User, evidence: "CLAUDE.md#Deployment" } spa: icon: logos:react label: Ledger Sync SPA note: "React 19, Vite, PWA" in: browser evidence: "frontend/vite.config.ts:58-63" # Stand-in: logos:pwa for Workbox (no Workbox icon). sw: icon: logos:pwa label: Service worker note: Workbox app shell only in: browser evidence: "frontend/vite.config.ts:64-118" # Stand-in: logos:github-icon. si:githubpages is a wordmark that reads as tiny text at 880px. pages: icon: logos:github-icon label: Static site note: /ledger-sync/ in: ghpages evidence: [".github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:92-110", "frontend/vite.config.ts:60"] api: icon: logos:fastapi-icon label: FastAPI backend note: Python serverless in: vercel evidence: ["backend/api/index.py:3", "backend/vercel.json:3-16"] google: icon: logos:google-icon label: Google OAuth in: oauth evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/api/oauth_providers.py:24", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/oauth.py:61"] github: icon: logos:github-icon label: GitHub OAuth in: oauth evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/api/oauth_providers.py:27-28", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/oauth.py:62-63"] # Pooler: CLAUDE.md Deployment table (brief) plus session.py URL normalization. db: icon: logos:neon-icon label: Neon PostgreSQL note: PgBouncer pooler in: neon evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/db/session.py:14-39", "backend/src/ledger_sync/db/session.py:60-66", "CLAUDE.md#Deployment"] # Stand-in: tabler:currency (no Frankfurter logo). fx: icon: tabler:currency label: Frankfurter API note: exchange rates in: market evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/exchange_rates.py:28-32" # Stand-in: logos:yahoo, the Yahoo brand mark. yahoo: icon: logos:yahoo label: Yahoo Finance note: stock prices in: market evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/stock_price.py:23" bedrock: icon: aws:bedrock label: Amazon Bedrock note: Converse in: llm evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat_bedrock.py:189-233" anthropic: icon: logos:anthropic-icon label: Anthropic API note: BYOK in: llm evidence: "frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:250" openai: icon: logos:openai-icon label: OpenAI API note: BYOK in: llm evidence: "frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:249" edges: # inferred - { from: user, to: spa, label: uses, evidence: "CLAUDE.md#Deployment" } # inferred: axios baseURL from VITE_API_BASE_URL - from: spa to: api label: "HTTPS /api, JWT" evidence: ["frontend/src/services/api/client.ts:223", ".github/workflows/deploy-frontend.yml:47-49#VITE_API_BASE_URL", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/main.py:325-331"] # declared: Workbox globPatterns - { from: sw, to: pages, label: precache shell, evidence: "frontend/vite.config.ts:94-118" } - { from: spa, to: google, label: authorize redirect, evidence: ["frontend/src/services/api/auth.ts:41", "frontend/src/services/api/auth.ts:235"] } - { from: spa, to: github, label: authorize redirect, evidence: ["frontend/src/services/api/auth.ts:42", "frontend/src/services/api/auth.ts:235"] } # token exchange, then Google userinfo (oauth.py:244) - { from: api, to: google, label: "code exchange, profile", evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/oauth.py:227-248" } # token exchange, then GitHub /user (oauth.py:311) and /user/emails (oauth.py:339) - { from: api, to: github, label: "code exchange, profile", evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/api/oauth.py:294-317", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/oauth.py:334-340"] } - { from: api, to: db, label: SQL, evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/db/session.py:39", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/deps.py:197"] } - { from: api, to: fx, label: rates, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/exchange_rates.py:100" } - { from: api, to: yahoo, label: quotes, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/stock_price.py:121" } # app credentials, or the user's own bearer key (ai_chat_bedrock.py:188-201) - { from: api, to: bedrock, label: "chat (app or BYOK key)", evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat_bedrock.py:233#converse", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat_bedrock.py:192-205"] } - { from: spa, to: anthropic, label: browser-direct, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:381" } - { from: spa, to: openai, label: browser-direct, evidence: "frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:289" }

svg.title: Ledger Sync system overview
svg.desc: Ledger Sync system overview. 13 components in 7 groups. Connections: User to Ledger Sync SPA (uses); Ledger Sync SPA to FastAPI backend (HTTPS /api, JWT); Service worker to Static site (precache shell); Ledger Sync SPA to Google OAuth (authorize redirect); Ledger Sync SPA to GitHub OAuth (authorize redirect); FastAPI backend to Google OAuth (code exchange, profile); FastAPI backend to GitHub OAuth (code exchange, profile); FastAPI backend to Neon PostgreSQL (SQL); FastAPI backend to Frankfurter API (rates); FastAPI backend to Yahoo Finance (quotes); FastAPI backend to Amazon Bedrock (chat (app or BYOK key)); Ledger Sync SPA to Anthropic API (browser-direct); Ledger Sync SPA to OpenAI API (browser-direct).

text.tspan: Production: the SPA from sagargupta.online/ledger-sync/ calls ledger-sync-api.vercel.app; local dev swaps in SQLite and the Vite proxy
